slides.text: How to build boxing cardio at home...
Jump rope: 3 rounds of 3 minutes, 1 minute rest.
Shadowbox 3 rounds: jab only, then combos, then nonstop.
30 seconds fast punches, 30 seconds slow. Repeat for a full round.

slides.needs: person doing plank in dim room
slides.text: Finish with core: plank and sit-ups, 3 rounds.
